items.headline: NFL Week 11: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
items.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 11.

items.headline: 'Locked into the moment,' Bryce Young rallies first-place Panthers past Ravens
items.description: In a back-and-forth game laced with lead changes, Bryce Young rallied the Panthers to a 35-33 home win over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday at Bank of America Stadium, a second straight victory for the 5-5 Panthers that padded lead in the NFC South.

items.headline: Jesse Minter: I take responsibility for latest Ravens loss
items.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter took accountability after Baltimore's 35-33 setback to the Panthers extended the NFL's longest active losing streak to six games.
